extension.description: Automatically configures Kodi's TV client for your BGPVR server: Simple Setup (IPTV Simple Client: live TV, guide, catch-up) or Advanced Setup (Tvheadend HTSP Client: adds recordings, timers and the recordings list). Sign in with your phone (scan the QR code Kodi shows and approve the box), or enter your server URL, username and password — Kodi does the rest. Live TV, EPG and recordings all set up in one step. To reconfigure: change settings and restart Kodi.

Автоматично конфигурира ТВ клиента на Kodi за вашия BGPVR сървър: Лесна настройка (IPTV Simple Client) или Разширена настройка (Tvheadend HTSP Client, със записи). Влезте с телефона (сканирайте QR кода и одобрете кутията) или въведете URL на сървъра, потребителско име и парола — Kodi прави останалото.
extension.news: v1.2.0 (6 Nov 2026) - Sign in with your phone: Kodi shows a QR code and a code like ABCD-EFGH; approve the box in My Account (or the BGPVR Player app on the phone) and Kodi sets up Live TV by itself (Simple Setup) - The box gets a sign-in of its own, listed in My Account > Devices as Kodi; signing it out there makes Kodi ask to sign in again at the next start. The account password is never stored on the box - Sign in another way keeps the username and password sign-in; Advanced Setup (recordings) still uses it - Installs that are already set up keep working with no change - Run now works (Add-ons > Program add-ons > BGPVR Setup > Run), and Settings has a Sign in with your phone button: sign in again or switch, with the phone, another way or Advanced Setup; the current sign-in stays until the new one succeeds - The sign-in screen has a solid background and a clear blue button; shorter setup messages that fit on screen v1.1.1 (1 Nov 2026) - Advanced Setup connects to the Tvheadend (HTSP) address and port the BGPVR server announces (suite 2.9.419+), so it works when the web address is behind Cloudflare; a manual address in Settings still wins v1.1.0 (1 Nov 2026) - Choose the TV client: Simple Setup (IPTV Simple Client: live TV, guide, catch-up) or Advanced Setup (Tvheadend HTSP Client: adds recordings, timers and the recordings list); asked once at first setup, changeable in Settings > TV client; the other client is disabled - On desktop Linux the TV clients come from the system: Setup shows the one command to run (sudo apt install kodi-pvr-iptvsimple or kodi-pvr-hts) - "Allow self-signed certificate" now takes effect (1.0.4 read it the wrong way on Kodi 19 and newer) v1.0.4 (1 Nov 2026) - Server certificates are checked; new Advanced setting "Allow self-signed certificate (not recommended)", off by default v1.0.3 (31 Oct 2026) - IPTV Simple M3U and EPG addresses use the stream token instead of the password; existing installs are moved over at the next Kodi start

extension.summary: BGPVR live TV, films and series
BGPVR телевизия на живо, филми и сериали
extension.description: Browse live TV channels by category, and watch your films and series in Kodi's own player, with posters, plots and resume. Credentials are shared with the BGPVR Setup addon — configure once, works everywhere.

Разглеждайте каналите по категории и гледайте филмите и сериалите си в плейъра на Kodi, с постери, описания и продължаване от мястото, където сте спрели. Данните за вход се споделят с BGPVR Setup addon.
extension.news: v1.1.3 (6 Nov 2026) - Plays on a box signed in with the phone (BGPVR Setup 1.2.0): its own device credential is the play token v1.1.2 (1 Nov 2026) - Server certificates are checked (Kodi's CA list); clear message when the check fails; self-signed only when allowed in BGPVR Setup > Advanced v1.1.1 (31 Oct 2026) - Play addresses carry the stream token, never the account password (fetched again once if the server refuses it) v1.1.0 (31 Oct 2026) - Films and Series: browse by category, seasons and episodes; play in Kodi's player (mkv too); Kodi resume - Main menu: Live TV, Films, Series - English and Bulgarian strings; API answers cached for 5 minutes; credentials never written to the log

extension.summary: Optimizes Kodi buffering for IPTV streaming
Оптимизира буферирането на Kodi за IPTV
extension.description: Writes an optimised advancedsettings.xml: 100 MB buffer, readfactor 8. One click — no more buffering or stuttering on live streams.
Записва оптимизиран advancedsettings.xml: 100MB буфер, readfactor 8. Един клик — без спиране на картината при гледане на Live TV.
Provides BGPVR Setup, BGPVR Live TV, and the Buffering Fix addon. Works with any BGPVR server — enter your URL, username and password.
